notes: New: HTTPS, the padlock in the browser. Your login and everything else to the map is encrypted
Choose a private certificate (no domain needed, import it once per device) or Let's Encrypt (for your own domain)
Set it up with one command (see the README or Settings → Secure connection); the map can also be opened by a name like flightmap.home
The old http address keeps working: it sends you to the secure one
Updates and backups keep the certificates, so your devices keep trusting the map
